notes: Wave 0 — native foundation: one authoritative typed contract (22 client / 27 server / 11 notify socket events), Android Room v4 offline core (outbox + drafts, non-destructive v3→v4 migration) with Keystore-backed secure session, iOS GRDB v2 offline core with Keychain session store, full socket registries with reconnect re-join on both platforms, outbox retry/sync engines (WorkManager / BGTask), automation-tested CI including real Socket.IO round-trips on both platforms and emulator/simulator launch gates.
